{{Quote|Many Hutt foods are quite delicious, including this "punky muffin" sandwich. A breakfast favorite on Nar Shaddaa, it features a Klatooine paddy frog sausage, Klatooine paddy frog sausage and a slice of jerba cheese on a Klatooine paddy frog sausage.|Dex's Diner menu, on the "Hungry Hutt" breakfast sandwich|<ref name="Dining at Dex's" />}}
'''Jerba cheese''' was a type of [[Cheese/Legends|cheese]] that could be sliced, shredded, and melted.<ref name="Dining at Dex's" /> The cheese shared its name with the [[Jerba/Legends|jerba]], a [[Species/Legends|species]] of pack animal [[Homeworld/Legends|native]]<ref name="Complete Encyclopedia">{{CSWECite|II|157|jerba}}</ref> to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]<ref name="Complete Encyclopedia" /> in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="Atlas" /> The [[Besalisk/Legends|Besalisk]] [[Chef/Legends|chef]] [[Dexter Jettster/Legends|Dexter Jettster]] used jerba cheese in several [[Foodstuff/Legends|dishes]] served at his [[Restaurant/Legends|restaurant]], [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]],<ref name="Dining at Dex's" /> on the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] planet<ref name="Atlas" /> [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. Jettster offered [[gartro egg omelet]]s filled with shredded jerba cheese for 7.5 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] and [[Nerf steak/Legends|fried nerfsteak]] smothered with melted jerba cheese for 14.7 credits. The diner also offered the [["Hungry Hutt" breakfast sandwich]], a breakfast favorite also found<ref name="Dining at Dex's" /> on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] which [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] homeworld of [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]] in [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]].<ref name="Lords of Nal Hutta">''[[Lords of Nal Hutta]]''</ref> The [[Sandwich/Legends|sandwich]] was made with a slice of jerba cheese and could be eaten by members of the Hutt species.<ref name="Dining at Dex's" />

==Behind the scenes==
Jerba cheese was mentioned in "[[Dining at Dex's]]," an article written by [[Gregory Walker]] as an [[in-universe]] menu for Dex's Diner that was published on the [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] section of [[StarWars.com]] on [[December 3]], [[2009]].<ref name="Dining at Dex's" />
